{{Quote|Pure cortosis gauntlet. All my Knights have them. The metal disrupts a lightsaber. Yours will be useless for the next few minutes.|Roan Fel, to Darth Kruhl|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 13">[[Legacy (2006) 13|''Legacy'' (2006) 13]]</ref>}}
'''Cortosis gauntlets''' were arm braces made with [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]] woven into them. Acting as protective shielding, the gauntlets were used by warriors who engaged in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. As cortosis was a naturally [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-resistant metal, when the blade of lightsabers came into contact with the gauntlet, the blade would short out for several minutes.
[[File:GiettKKruhk_JCAOW.jpg|thumb|Micah Giiett's cortosis vambrace]]
During the [[Yinchorri Uprising]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Micah Giiett]] owned a cortosis [[Vambrace/Legends|vambrace]], and used it to educate padawans about lightsaber-resistant materials.

[[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Sajé Tasha]] wore a pair of clawed cortosis gauntlets during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: Trackdown">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Trackdown]]''</ref>

These gauntlets were worn by all of the [[Imperial Knight]]s who served [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]], and Fel, being a fully trained Knight himself, also wore a pair. [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Kruhl|Kruhl]] was surprised to find his weapon deactivate in the midst of [[Duel on Bastion|dueling]] Emperor Fel on [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]].<ref name="Legacy (2006) 13" />

==Behind the scenes==
According to [[Jan Duursema]], [[Darth Talon]] was able to cut off [[Elke Vetter]]'s hand despite her cortosis gauntlets because she cut at the point where the bracer and hand guard join, between the cortosis armor plates.<ref>{{DHBoards|url=viewtopic.php?t=16707#236057|thread=About the Imperial Knights' cortosis gaunltets|user=[[Jan Duursema|jan duursema]]|date=2010-01-02|time=10:42 pm}}</ref>
